summary: Novita AI for Startups offers up to $10,000 in usage credits across Novita's Model APIs (LLM, image, video, voice) and Agent Sandbox: $1,000 upfront, the next $5,000 matched 1:1 (every dollar spent earns a dollar of credit), and the final $4,000 matched 2:1 (every two dollars spent earns one). Credits are redeemable for one year and split up to $5K Agent Sandbox + $5K Model API. Eligibility: venture-backed and Series B or earlier, AI-native product, new Novita user. Applications are reviewed on stage, team, spend, backing, traction, and expected usage.
claim_steps: Apply via the Google Form linked from https://startups.novita.ai/ .
Eligibility: VC-backed, Series B or earlier, AI-native product, new Novita user.
On approval: $1K upfront credit, then spend-match to unlock the rest (1:1 up to $5K, then 2:1 up to $4K); redeemable for one year.
